profile.headline: Software Engineering graduate of Iowa State University
profile.summary: I am a graduate from Iowa State University in the field of Software Engineering. I have had one full time professional position and two professional intern experiences. I am currently searching for a software engineering development role, but I am open to other related opportunities as well.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recent experience orchestrating software solutions following the agile process including requirements gathering, platform architecture, tool selection, software architecture, iterative development, testing, user feedback, change management, integration and deployment. 

Customer service QnABot
  ◦ Lead team to two to develop a chat bot using QnABot, Lex, and lambda
  ◦ Increased support team productivity drastically by replacing live chat and phone number
  ◦ Log feedback for continuous improvements
  ◦ Altered UI library for custom UI Look
Set Up AWS Core architecture and services
  ◦ Leveraged S3, DynamoDB, Lambdas, SQS, ect, to build out the AWS IOT Core
  ◦ Enables hundreds of thousands of packets of data to be processed and stored daily
  ◦ Alerts and emails the relevant groups should any errors happen on IOT Core
Kinesis Video Streaming POC
  ◦ Lead proof of concept to completion
  ◦ Developed a POC video stream with a Raspberry PI, Kinesis Video Stream, and web page 
  ◦ Enables the storage of video for up to 10 years
  ◦ Allows users to play video live, on demand, and even download videos in a time frame
E2E Testing
  ◦ Lead multiple projects in this area
  ◦ Utilized Cypress to orchestrate company wide UI and API end to end testing
  ◦ Developed and architected solution to employ an infinite amount of emails, send data to those 
     emails, and retrieve the data
  ◦ Extended the existing library for Cypress to make custom commands
  ◦ Saved hundreds a month by discovering a free workaround to the paid solution
Load Testing
  ◦ Lead multiple projects in this area
  ◦ Utilized JMeter to employ company wide UI and API Load testing
  ◦ Developed and architected solution to utilize free proxies from the web and ensure that they 
     work discarding ones that do not
  ◦ Saved hundreds in testing costs a month by leveraging JMeter and free proxies

For a complete list, please download the attached pdf.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Auditing program 
  ◦ Aided in creating infrastructure spanning every production server worldwide
  ◦ Compiled thousands of pages of product docs into well formatted and easy-to-read guides
  ◦ Enabled the tracking and investigation of key company asset failures
  ◦ Prevented company loss by finding key software was already under license
  ◦ Mastered working in a virtual environment with global team members
YubiKey
   ◦ Created a POC using the Yubikey 4 to log into Windows 7 and Windows 10
   ◦ Secured passwords through Two Factor Authentication while simplifying access for users
   ◦ Directed the effort several teams contributing to the YubiKey project
   ◦ Verified FIDO2 was not ready for use minimizing loss in company resources

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Rewrote an existing Java application in a newer Java Framework
Migrated from an existing IBM DB2 database to a lightweight PostgreSQL solution
Managed feature schedule and development efforts to meet requirements
Created a front end that met the latest User Experience John Deere standards
